_meta.builder: df5 merge step (/tmp/df5d_merge/merge.py); inputs clean/proj/MANIFEST_proj.json + clean/pub/_manifest_pub.json
_meta.cut: 2014-12-31 (every series truncated on load; no 2015+ value read into the outputs)
_meta.format: clean/<ID>.csv: columns date,r; r = simple daily total return in decimal, USD; DatetimeIndex
_meta.selection_rule: 1) longer daily USD total-return coverage (price-only pieces do not count), 2) ACTUAL over PROXY, 3) tie -> project build (NYSE calendar). Overrides are marked QUALITY OVERRIDE in choice_reason.
_meta.calendar_note: KF-based series start 1926 and include NYSE Saturday sessions before 1952-05; the only gap > 5 weekdays is the 1933-03-03..1933-03-15 bank holiday (market closed, not missing data). research/data/INDEX.md restricts pre-1970 rows for some threads.
_meta.origin_copies: clean/proj/<ID>.csv and clean/pub/<ID>.csv are the per-builder copies; clean/<ID>.csv is the chosen series (byte copy of its origin file).
_meta.license: Ken French data: internal research use, no redistribution; Yahoo/Twelve Data/FRED/Bundesbank: internal use

USD.label: PROXY->ACTUAL
USD.kind: PROXY (DXY spot + T-bill + rate-differential carry = synthetic fully-collateralized USDX futures) then ACTUAL ETF total return (UUP)
source: Yahoo DX-Y.NYB (ICE US Dollar Index spot) change + KF daily RF + (US 3m - DXY-weighted foreign 3m interbank rate, prior-month avg, FRED OECD)/252

segments.source: synthetic fully collateralized USDX futures: DXY spot change + KF RF + DXY-weighted 3m rate differential

USD.choice_reason: pub covers 1982-02 vs proj 2007-03 (UUP only); the pub proxy includes carry and collateral, so it is a total-return proxy. Longer coverage wins.
USD.notes: Carry weights = DXY weights EUR .576 (Germany 3m pre-1999), JPY .136 (3m CD rate pre-2002-04), GBP .119, CAD .091, SEK .042, CHF .036 (CHF pre-1999-07 filled with German rate). Starts 1982-02 because SEK 3m starts 1982-01. Synthetic vs UUP 2007-03..2014: see stats; daily corr ~0.90 (DXY spot index timing vs ETF close). DTWEXM/DTWEXB/DTWEXO (FRED, noon NY) raw in raw/pub. Overlap 2007-03..2014: synthetic vs UUP daily corr 0.903, weekly 0.962, TE 3.9%/yr, ann gap +1.7%/yr (UUP fee 0.75% + futures/roll effects); DXY spot alone gap +1.3%/yr.

alternatives.kind: ACTUAL UUP adjclose TR (USDX futures, carry included)
